meta.title: System configuration and topology
meta.subtitle: Game/Ops browsers · Gateway/Ops · two ZoneNodes on zoneworld.mesh RouteMesh + broadcast fanout

cards.title: ZoneWorld connections and roles
items: Gateway manages game sessions and relays player messages to two ZoneNode processes.
The play nodes synchronize zone boundaries over the zoneworld.mesh RouteMesh. Actor relocation across a boundary keeps the client session open.
Ops receives announcements and maintenance commands over a separate control STREAM, fans them out over zoneworld.broadcast, and collects zone Spot events.
Both processes register the same zone Spot and player Actor factories. Each process owns a subset of the zones according to Location Store placement.
